The entire proceedings,
according to us is nothing but an abuse of process of law.
High Court should have entertained the petition filed appellant under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and quashed the FIR as well as the criminal proceedings.
We are of the considered view that the FIR lodged by the complainant against the appellant is nothing but an  process of law.

Under these circumstances, the appeal is allo  3 chargesheet, which has been submitted before the competent court by Police Station, Shankargarh, District Balrampur-Ramanujganj in pursuance of Crime No. 87/2023, registered against the appellant for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n), 417, 506 of Indian Penal Code as well as the criminal proceeding of Criminal Miscellaneous Case No.406/2023 and all further proceedings of the Trial Court are hereby quashed.
